name: Candilicious
summary:
Welcome to Candilicious, a colourful 360° VR adventure where mischievous Nib Nibs are stealing your sweets! Defend your candy with four unique weapons, unlock upgrades and battle through 30 levels across candy, cookie and chocolate worlds. Face sneaky thieves, flying monsters and three epic bosses. Dodge attacks, use strategic towers and power-ups, and master the chaos across three difficulty modes.

Save the stash. Beat the bosses. Keep the candy!
